fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: Throws a gaff that deals 20 piercing damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Marking Gaff
fusions.desc: A quick gaff that deals 4 piercing damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fresh Scent
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
